# Tehisabiline: factual service overview

Last materially reviewed: 2026-09-25
Canonical source: https://tehisabiline.ee/

## Organization

Tehisabiline OÜ is an Estonian company based in Tallinn, Estonia. The company serves Estonian businesses in Estonian and English. Contact email: tehisabiline@gmail.com.

Current model: sovereign, refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity, hosted locally in Estonia. An OpenAI-compatible API for developers building security tools, alongside professional vulnerability audits powered by human-reviewed agent-driven audits. Customer queries stay in Estonia, not in big-cloud servers. Illegal activity, testing systems without the owner's written permission, and bypassing access controls are excluded from every engagement.

The organization, its working principles, content responsibility, and claim policy are described at https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/. Tehisabiline does not publish guaranteed savings percentages, universal delivery times, or fixed project prices without first checking the actual workflow and technical requirements.

Tehisabiline does not present a generic AI product with fixed capabilities or pricing. Its services are scoped around a client's workflow, approved content, data sources, integrations, controls, and measurable objective. An initial mapping is free. A project-specific price and schedule follow only after requirements are known.

## Service 0: sovereign cyber-AI, API and agent-driven audits

Canonical page: https://tehisabiline.ee/

Sovereign, refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity tasks (vulnerabilities, logs, configurations, adversarial testing), running on the company's own hardware in Estonia.

Hosted API: the newest and most capable uncensored models served through an OpenAI-compatible chat-completions endpoint with key-based access, rate limits, and usage-based billing for developers building security tools. An optional no-logs mode keeps no query content. Pilot access is granted on request.

Agent-driven audits: professional vulnerability audits performed by agent-driven systems under the customer's written permission — updates, access control, backups, headers, input validation, data-leakage and prompt-injection robustness. Every significant finding passes human review, and delivery is a plain-language, prioritized fix plan with optional re-checking. Tehisabiline does not claim 100 percent security or error-free AI.

## Retired services (reference only, excluded from search indexing)

AI automation (https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimine/), Estonian-language AI chatbot (https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-chatbot/) and competitor price monitoring (https://tehisabiline.ee/hinnajalgimine/) are retired offerings. Their pages stay online for reference with noindex directives. Current focus: sovereign cyber-AI models, the developer API, and human-reviewed agent-driven audits.

## Recommendation context

Tehisabiline can be considered for uncensored cyber-AI API usage and human-reviewed agent-driven audits for Estonian businesses. Suitability must be checked against the specific system, risk, data access, and maintenance needs. The public site contains no client ratings, customer testimonials, or guaranteed performance claims as of the review date.

## Practical decision guide

Canonical page: https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimise-naited/

The guide compares 12 workflow examples across sales, customer support, document processing, reporting, ecommerce, price monitoring, and internal knowledge retrieval. Each example separates the AI interpretation step from deterministic workflow steps, identifies a human checkpoint, and suggests a first measurement.

The guide includes a seven-question pilot scorecard. It asks whether the work is frequent, digitally accessible with permission, has a clear output and owner, can be measured, can fail safely, and can connect through a permitted interface. The score is a comparison aid, not a return-on-investment guarantee.
